itemText: Add a triage on/off setting, off by default, stored with the other app settings and returned with the triage count.
With triage off, cards made from notes or typed by hand are saved as approved and studyable at once, keeping only the first variant for phrase notes.
With triage off, the duplicate check still runs on new cards and holds a likely duplicate in triage instead of approving it.
Web settings get the triage toggle, and the web sidebar hides the triage link when triage is off and nothing is waiting.
Mac and iPhone settings get the triage toggle, and both apps hide the triage tab and badge when triage is off and nothing is waiting.
With triage off, the duplicate check still runs on new cards and holds a likely duplicate in triage instead of approving it.

Every new card passes one bulk duplicate lookup before it is saved, and a card whose question and answer both match an existing card is skipped, while the same phrase asked from a different angle is kept.

With triage off, a card made from a new note is studyable in its subject without any triage step.
A setting in web and the Mac and iPhone apps turns triage on and off, and its default is off.
With triage off, the triage tab and badge are hidden in web and the apps.
Subjects store an Easy, Normal or Cram level that sets how far apart reviews are, with sub-subjects using the nearest parent's level and Normal as the default.
The subject options screen in web and the apps lets the learner pick the level and previews the next gap for Good and Easy.
Creating a subject or sub-subject in web and the apps lets the learner pick the level, with sub-subjects offered Inherit.

The subject options screen in web and the apps lets the learner pick the level and previews the next gap for Good and Easy.
Creating a subject or sub-subject in web and the apps lets the learner pick the level, with sub-subjects offered Inherit.
A card in an Easy subject gets a Good gap roughly twice as long as the same card in a Cram subject, and Normal keeps today's gaps.
A sub-subject without its own level uses the nearest parent's level, and a top-level subject defaults to Normal.
The subject create form and the subject options screen, in web and the apps, let the learner pick the level.
The options screen previews the next gap for Good and Easy at the chosen level.

With triage off, the import sweep counts approved cards that have never been studied and holds back imported notes while that count is at the cap, and with triage on it keeps counting cards waiting in triage.
A one-off script reports how many waiting triage cards it would add to each subject, and with its apply flag approves them so they become studyable, changing nothing on a second run.

With triage on, the sweep keeps counting cards waiting in triage, as it does today.

The script by default only reports how many waiting cards it would add to each subject.
